title: ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender
snippet: We propose Assess $\to$ Decide $\to$ Respond, a framework in which the defender assesses the user's intent, commits to an explicit, parseable safety decision, and only then generates a reply conditioned on it, with the commitment trained by reinforcement learning at the payload turn.
